title: Start Here — Send One Exact Japan Requirement
description: The fastest way to use JPNentry: send one exact maker, part/model/reference, quantity, destination and timing. Quote-ready RFQs go directly to sourcing; Rescue tiers are for genuine research work.
content:
Start with one exact requirementJPNentry is a Japan-based sourcing and verification desk. The fastest way to get a useful answer is to send one exact requirement rather than a broad product category.
What to sendExact maker + exact part/model/reference + quantity + destination + timing. Add a clear nameplate or reference photo when fitment or revision matters.
If your RFQ is already quote-readyIf the exact item, quantity and destination are already clear enough for a commercial quote, JPNentry moves directly to Japan-side sourcing and quote preparation. We do not force a paid research fee onto a quote-ready RFQ.
If the request needs rescue sourcingVerified Rescue tiers currently available are Standard USD 49, Priority USD 149 and Emergency USD 499. These fees cover Japan-side sourcing/research work only; product cost, freight, duties, taxes and third-party charges are separate unless explicitly included in a written quote.
Buyer Rescue Ticket: https://form.jotform.com/262572392466061
What JPNentry will not promise before verificationWe do not guarantee stock, compatibility, savings, exportability, supplier allocation or delivery before the exact requirement and current Japan-side evidence are verified.
Contact: jpnentry.sales@gmail.com

title: JPNentry Trust Center — How We Verify, Quote and Protect the Buyer
description: A current, non-promotional trust standard for JPNentry: what we verify, what counts as evidence, what happens before payment, and what we never claim without proof.
content:
Trust should come from evidence, not claimsJPNentry is designed for overseas buyers who need a Japan-side sourcing route without taking unnecessary inventory risk. We separate verified facts from assumptions and keep the buyer approval gate before procurement whenever commercially possible.
What we verify for a live requirementDepending on the item, we verify the exact specification, obtainable quantity, condition, current supplier or seller identity, current unit cost, Japan domestic freight, testing or evidence available, lead time, quote validity, return/cancellation terms and relevant export limitations.
What counts as stock evidenceCurrent supplier confirmation, current dated inventory evidence, current quote or direct seller response can support an availability claim. Old listings, cached pages and historical marketplace records are treated only as market signals until commercially verified.
Before a buyer-facing numeric quoteJPNentry checks procurement cost, Japan domestic freight, inspection/testing where relevant, packing/documents, international freight when known, insurance when relevant, payment fees, FX and return risk, and JPNentry margin. Unknown items remain identified as unknown rather than being invented.
Payment and procurement gatePayment instructions are issued only after explicit buyer acceptance or within a clearly defined paid Rescue Ticket flow. JPNentry does not commit inventory, place a binding purchase order, make a supplier transfer or reserve stock with JPNentry funds without the required approval gate.
What we never claim without proofWe do not fabricate customers, testimonials, supplier allocation, stock, lead times, savings, fitment, scarcity or delivery. A prospect is not a client, a quote is not revenue, and a retail listing is not verified B2B supply.
Contact: jpnentry.sales@gmail.com
